decision: Approve a private AI review loop for internal decisions
desired_outcome: Pilot one local-first AI workflow with evidence and human sign-off
current_context: Teams are experimenting with AI tools, but private briefs, unsupported claims, and unclear ownership slow approval of useful workflows.
constraints: No customer data leaves the machine
One team and a six-week pilot

options.title: Local-first review loop
options.description: A no-key workflow that keeps the brief local, flags weak claims, and exports a receipt-backed deck.

options.title: Hosted AI workspace
options.description: An optional provider workflow with a disclosed network boundary and explicit data review.

evidence.label: Internal AI workflow inventory
evidence.evidence: Author-owned synthetic inventory of candidate internal workflows.

next_step: Run a ten-brief local pilot and inspect every receipt with security
